_about: NWIOI track catalog: what each credential's tiers include and cost. status 'approved' = shown to the public; 'draft' = shown only in preview (local preview or a signed-in admin). Credentials (AASECT) set the requirements; tiers are what someone buys from NWIOI.

recommendation._note: If someone has already done at least this share of the credential's supervision target, they no longer need a full supervision package, so Modular is recommended.

payInFull._note: Pay in full: package tuition x (1 - rate), rounded to the cent. Add-ons (e.g. Core SAR) stay at full price. Modular is excluded.

scholarship.title: FIELD Growth Scholarship
scholarship.copy: NWIOI offers a discounted rate for people with marginalized and intersecting identities who are underrepresented in sex therapy, sexuality counseling, or sexuality education and are experiencing financial need.
scholarship._note: Award amounts and whether they combine with pay-in-full savings are decided by NWIOI through the scholarship process, not the calculator.
